text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ruling Kenya African National Union party elections in Central province go smoothly.
- The presidents of Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda meet on Tuesday to launch a common passport for the three countries.
- Detectives arrest a former police officer suspected to have masterminded the theft of 96 million shillings from Standard Chartered bank in Nairobi in February.
- Opposition FORD-Asili party chairman Kenneth Matiba dismisses the suggestion that the party will not sponsor him in the general election.
- The Roman Catholic church steps up pressure on the government to allow constitutional reforms.
- Parliament's Public Investment Committee accuses the clerk of the national assembly of sabotaging its work. ($1=53 Kenyan shillings)
